sentences.en: This street will come alive with shoppers on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 这个街区在星期六会因为购物者的到来而热闹起来。

sentences.en: Shoppers lined up to purchase a popular role-playing game.
sentences.zh: 人们排起了长队购买一款热门的角色扮演游戏。

sentences.en: I'm not wealthy enough to afford a personal shopper.
sentences.zh: 我的经济条件不允许我请一个私人购物者。
